steps: Fix the interfaces from the user's words: base leg 4 x M6 to the plate (R03); carrying leg 2 x M5, 40 mm apart horizontally (R06), hole centres 35 mm above the plate (R08).
Size clearance holes per STD-ISO273-MEDIUM: M6 -> 6.6 mm, M5 -> 5.5 mm.
Choose width, leg lengths and base-hole layout so every hole centre is >= 1.5 d from free edges (GL-HOLE-EDGE-DISTANCE) and clear of the bend.
Choose thickness from the bending hand calculation with the user's lever arm (R07) and the assumed design load (A03, A02); respect min wall (DFM-MACH-WALL-MIN).
Internal bend radius per DFM-MACH-INNER-RADIUS-MIN and DFM-DFMEA-FATIGUE-FILLET.
Build the parametric model in Fusion; inspect read-only; validate; review.

bracket_thickness.rationale: Engineering decision: hand calc with the assumed load gives a large margin already at 4 mm; 5 mm chosen for bolt-clamping stiffness.

bend_inner_radius.rationale: >= 3 mm end-mill rule and >= 0.2 t fatigue rule.

bracket_width.rationale: User M5 spacing 40 mm (R06) + 2 x 1.5 x 5.5 mm edge distance = 56.5 mm minimum -> 60 mm.

leg_base_length.rationale: Last base hole row at 52 mm + 1.5 x 6.6 mm = 61.9 mm minimum -> 64 mm.

leg_upright_height.rationale: User hole height 35 mm (R08) + 1.5 x 5.5 mm = 43.25 mm minimum -> 50 mm.

base_hole_diameter.rationale: ISO 273 medium clearance for the user's M6 bolts.

base_hole_x0.rationale: Engineering decision: socket access next to the carrying leg (A06).

base_hole_pitch_x.rationale: Engineering decision: spread the four M6 bolts along the base to resist the overturning moment; plate drilled to suit (A05).

base_hole_pitch_y.rationale: Side edge distance (30 - 18) = 12 mm = 1.82 d >= 1.5 d.

upright_hole_diameter.rationale: ISO 273 medium clearance for the user's M5 bolts.

upright_hole_z0.rationale: User: hole centres 35 mm above the flat plate (R08 interpretation of M06).

upright_hole_pitch_z.rationale: Single row of holes (R06) - not used.

upright_hole_pitch_y.rationale: User: M5 bolts 40 mm apart horizontally.

upright_hole_rows.rationale: Two bolts side by side horizontally (R06 interpretation).

load_case.description: Box weight 2 kg (R02) x assumed factor 5 (A03) = 98.1 N acting at the user's centre-of-mass offset of 40 mm (R07) from the carrying-leg face: constant bending moment on that leg.

new_assumptions.text: ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION (not stated by the user): M6 hex-head bolts with washers installed from above with a socket; >= 15 mm from hole centre to the inner face of the carrying leg.
new_assumptions.rationale: Tool access for the base bolts next to the carrying leg.

verification_plan: Pre-CAD (Python): manufacturing rules and the bending hand calculation.
Fusion (read-only): body count, feature health, sketches constrained, bbox, volume vs analytic model, parameters vs record.
Own hole geometry: all 4 M6 and 2 M5 holes at designed position, axis and diameter. Mating fit with plate and sensor box will remain NOT_VERIFIED (parts not modelled).
